quests.name: Deep Cover
quests.text: Travel to the Venture Co. Tower, north of the Sludge Fen and contact the Shattered Hand's covert operative, Taskmaster Fizzule.  When the tower is in sight, use the Flare Gun to signal your arrival to Taskmaster Fizzule. Fire off TWO flares, then approach Taskmaster Fizzule and perform the Shattered /Salute.  These actions must be performed in the correct order, as Fizzule will attack and terminate any person he does not recognize.

quests.name: The Shattered Salute

quests.text: Travel to Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills and deliver the Sample of Zanzil's Mixture to Serge Hinott.  To get to Tarren Mill, take the Zeppelin to the Undercity and follow the road south through Silverpine and towards Hillsbrad. Follow the signs!

quests.text: To become a Weaponsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Borgosh: 4 Moonsteel Broadswords, 4 Massive Iron Axes, 2 Heavy Mithril Axes, and 2 Big Black Maces.

notes: Accepting the quest gives you the barrel item. Keep it in your bags because you hand it in at the end.

notes: Ag'tor in Azshara hands over the head item when you accept. It must still be in your bags when you turn in.

quests.name: Dearest Elenia,
quests.text: Deliver the Slightly Creased Note to Elenia Haydon near the bank in the Undercity.

quests.text: Visit the Midsummer camps located in Azshara, Silithus, Un'Goro Crater, and Winterspring, then return to the Festival Flamekeeper.
notes: The quest is only available during the Midsummer Fire Festival world event.

notes: You can only do this during the Midsummer Fire Festival world event.

quests.name: The Darkmoon Faire

notes: The turn-in NPC is not in the world until you summon it with the whistle.

objectives.text: Go to the docks of Ratchet in the Barrens.

objectives.text: Go to the Mor'shan Rampart in the Barrens.

notes: You start and finish the quest with the orphan, so it has to be summoned with the whistle when you reach the spot.

quests.text: Get some Strawberry Ice Cream for your ward. The lad seems to prefer Tigule's brand ice cream.

objectives.text: Go to the old Lordaeron Throne Room that lies just before descending into the Undercity.

quests.name: A Warden of the Horde
quests.text: Return your ward to the Orgrimmar orphanage by handing in the Orcish Orphan Whistle to Orphan Matron Battlewail in the Valley of Honor.

quests.name: Great-father Winter is Here!
quests.text: Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Orgrimmar.
notes: This quest is only available while the Feast of Winter Veil holiday event is running.

quests.name: Treats for Great-father Winter
quests.text: Bring 5 Gingerbread Cookies and an Ice Cold Milk to Greatfather Winter in Orgrimmar.
notes: The quest only runs during the Feast of Winter Veil. The cookies need Cooking skill 1 and the recipe from the goblin vendor.

quests.name: The Reason for the Season
quests.text: Speak with Sagorne Creststrider in the Valley of Wisdom of Orgrimmar about the Feast of Winter Veil.
notes: Only available during the Feast of Winter Veil holiday event.

quests.name: The Feast of Winter Veil
quests.text: Feel free to read the book, "The Feast of Winter Veil", to learn more about the holiday. When you are finished with the book, deliver it to Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Hallow's End Treats for Spoops!
quests.text: Speak with the innkeepers of Orgrimmar, Undercity, and Thunder Bluff, as well as Kali Remik in Sen'jin Village. Perform the tricks they ask of you in exchange for the treats they offer.  Return to Spoops at the Orgrimmar Orphanage with a Thunder Bluff Marzipan, Darkspear Gumdrop, Orgrimmar Nougat, and Undercity Mint.
notes: This quest is only available during Hallow's End and needs level 10.

quests.name: Flexing for Nougat
quests.text: Do a flex emote at Innkeeper Gryshka, and in exchange you'll receive Orgrimmar Nougat!
notes: You can only get this quest during the Hallow's End holiday.

quests.name: Stolen Winter Veil Treats
quests.text: Locate the Smokywood Pastures investigator that has gone missing in the snowy regions of the Alterac Mountains.

quests.name: Metzen the Reindeer
quests.text: Find Metzen the Reindeer. Use the notes provided to you for clues as to where he is being held.  When you find Metzen, have the Pouch of Reindeer Dust in your possession so you can sprinkle some of the dust on him; this should free Metzen from his bonds of captivity.  Return the Pouch of Reindeer Dust to Kaymard Copperpinch in Orgrimmar once Metzen is freed.

quests.name: Stolen Winter Veil Treats

notes: This quest is only available during the Winter Veil holiday event.

notes: The quest is only available during the Winter Veil holiday event.
